metadata.note: FontCLIP embeddings blended with Google Fonts structural-tag probabilities (logistic regression) and measured proportions from the font files (width, x-height), laid out with t-SNE; neighbours are k-NN in the same space. Fonts with identical Latin renders (and Playwrite Guides) are folded into one representative, listed in its `aliases`.

structural_categories.rule: Theme/Blackletter tag -> blackletter; Google 'display' fonts with a Google /Theme/Wacky score >= 70 -> decorative; other 'display' fonts by dominant tag: Sans/* -> sans-serif, Serif/* and Slab/* -> serif, Script/* -> handwriting, Monospace/* -> monospace, other Theme/* or no tag -> decorative; manual category_overrides win

search_tags.rule: `tags`: Google Fonts structural tags and form themes (incl. Wacky) scoring >= 50, strongest first, plus the dominant real style_tag; predicted tags only live in style_tag (style_tag_predicted = true)
